fact: The Central African Republic is listed among the 49 countries that signed the Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence at Kigali on 4 April 2025, alongside the African Union and Smart Africa.
Central African Republic sent a delegation to the fourth extraordinary session of the ARTAC regulators' conference held in Libreville on 20-21 October 2026, per GabonReview.
Smart Africa names the Central African Republic among the 19 signatories of the SATA Declaration on digital trust and cross-border interoperability.
